amendment.note: GPU0 originals started under the earlier approval at 12:39 CT. This is a post-start scope correction, not a retrospective pre-outcome declaration. Their questions, order, weights, settings and capture are unchanged. Keep completed records; do not rerun. The separate GPU1 replication is stopped and retained outside primary analysis.

hypothesis: The capability leaves a recurring structural difference between correct and incorrect computation traces. The existing questions on one arithmetic condition can expose where each failure carries that difference.
what_went_wrong_before: Cross-card arithmetic differences were allowed to drive smaller groups, matched-cell acquisition and a statistical gate. Those choices tested population separation instead of following the recurring structural difference through the existing responses.
why_this_direction: Run the existing originals on GPU0 to remove arithmetic-condition variation. This prepares the same questions for overlay of their correct and wrong traces, located by layer, component and answer position. It changes the condition, not the sample size.
why_it_might_be_wrong: A visible difference may reflect numerical inputs, wording or an error already emitted. A common card removes only the hardware confound. The next overlap must inspect each failure and compare the structure directly across the existing parameter variations; pre-error support is necessary evidence, not causal proof.
repeating_pattern_check: A setup artifact repeatedly became a reason to change the scientific question. This amendment cancels new-question acquisition, count matching and population-null gates. The existing response paths remain the object of investigation.

rule.primary: Finish only the 45 frozen original questions on GPU0 with the unchanged original BF16 model, greedy settings and qualified projection recorder. Use completed GPU0 records; never rerun them.
rule.new_questions: None. No screening, matched-cell quotas, active prefixes or enlargement. The previously generated question manifests remain historical proposal metadata and authorize no executions.
rule.classification: Read each complete natural response. Separate numerical successes, final-climb-includes-descent failures and other error types; report all originals. Preserve prose caveats and caps. No matching-based exclusion and no trace score determines eligibility.
rule.first_error: Mark the first wrong quantitative statement, first wrong mathematical token and any earlier ambiguous premise. The prediction emitting that token still has a pre-error prefix; later predictions are error-conditioned. Report each failure before, at and after the boundary, aligned to success positions; future targets require pre-error support.
rule.next_overlap: Overlay successes and failures, retain the recurring structural difference, and report whether each failure carries it, its layers/components and its first appearance. Check m, v and drop directly on the existing traces. Matched-cell design, Monte Carlo null and Clopper-Pearson calculations are not gates.
rule.replication: Stop the already-running GPU1 replication after its current completed prompt. Keep completed and any partial records, explicitly outside primary analysis; do not finish its queue.
rule.retention: Qualified observe-stream, projection retention, unchanged inference, natural greedy answers. All decisions retain the same residual boundaries and projection inputs named in STREAM-RECORDER.md. Reduced retention is labeled; it is not a full per-weight contribution capture.
rule.export_qualification: Before exporting the new cohort, read the existing qualified GPU0 projection capture; enumerate every recorded residual layer and its three ADD merges; verify incoming + branch equals merged in native float32 bytes at every prediction; compare the derived direction changes and L2 norms with the retained original full-response turns. Projection inputs stay in the unmodified native stream, indexed by label and token position. This export is data retention, not an overlap or target selection.
rule.storage: All outputs stay in this run folder. Use torad-research for verified R2 archival if local retention requires it. No unverified removal or shared input changes.
rule.next_construction: No weight edit or influence probe before a separately declared, independently accepted same-card structural-overlap analysis.

prediction.expected_observation: One GPU0 record for every existing original, with all recorded merges and matrix inputs preserved. The already-observed procedure error is expected to recur in some responses; exact common-card outcome counts are measured, not forced by acquisition.
prediction.failures_only: Original model only: report every target failure, numerical success, other error and cap. No repairs or regressions are claimed.
prediction.scope: The earlier expansion prediction is superseded, not backfilled. No new native answer was generated from its candidate pool.

would_weaken_it: The existing failures do not carry a common structural difference, the difference appears only after the first wrong token, or it tracks parameters/wording rather than the erroneous procedure. Report that directly; do not expand the sample to repair the result.

design_check.question_choice: Exactly the existing original-question manifest; serves trace-by-trace recurrence and continuity with prior observation.
design_check.hardware: GPU0 only for compared traces; removes arithmetic-condition variation.
design_check.grouping: Natural procedure labels, with every original in the denominator; no matched-cell subset.
design_check.measurement: Connected changes at the 105 recorded merges, components from native inputs and original weights, and per-failure pre-error location. No population-significance gate.
confounds: mass, speed and descent checked directly on existing traces
error consequences after the first wrong token
missing aligned positions and prose inconsistencies

original_count.derivation: Enumerate every eligible identity in parameters_by_case; no sampling.

max_tokens.derivation: Every retained question uses this natural generation limit; hold it unchanged for comparability.

reviews.status: Scope follows Marcos decision relayed by Claude. Revised declaration submitted; no additional original rerun or screening is authorized by submission.
